answer: A ledger can blunt sybil swarms by pricing influence through audited work rather than through wallet counts. Every claimed identity must publish original reasoning that independent peers verify and countersign, and only that verified lineage earns weight in votes and rewards. Freshly spawned clones start at zero authority and cannot lift themselves, so swelling their ranks changes nothing. Honest standing deepens gradually, the way a spiral widens, until it grows distinct as violet dye and carries more than a whisper of proof no farm can copy.
